description:
## What

Annotate every public surface in pkix-profiles-cabf and pkix-lint-cabf that asserts a CA/B Forum BR rule with two things:

1. A markdown link pointing to the canonical CABF source (specific section URL, not the repo root)
2. A standardized PR invitation: 'this crate is a reference, not authoritative, interpretation of the BR text; if you find a divergence between what is enforced here and what the BR says, please open an issue or PR.'

Goal: make the unprincipled-exception maintenance burden community-shareable. Anyone reading the crate who spots a divergence from current BR has a clear, low-friction path to contribute a fix, instead of needing the maintainer to notice.

## Where the annotations go

### Crate-level rustdoc (lib.rs top)

Add a 'Reporting divergences' section after the 'Unprincipled exception' section already present in both crates. Suggested text:

> # Reporting divergences
>
> This crate is a snapshot interpretation of the CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements as of <ballot or doc version stamp>. The canonical source is the CA/B Forum's published BR text; this crate is reference, not authoritative.
>
> If you find that a constraint in this crate differs from what the current CA/B Forum BR says — wrong section reference, outdated rule, missing new ballot — please open an issue or PR at <https://github.com/MarkAtwood/crate-pkix>. Divergence fixes are welcomed from anyone in the community; you do not need to be a maintainer.
>
> For the canonical BR sources:
> - TLS BR: <https://github.com/cabforum/servercert/blob/main/docs/BR.md>
> - EV Guidelines: <https://github.com/cabforum/servercert/blob/main/docs/EVG.md>
> - S/MIME BR: <https://github.com/cabforum/smime/blob/main/SBR.md>
> - Code Signing BR: <https://github.com/cabforum/code-signing/blob/main/docs/CSBR.md>

### Per-Profile / per-Lint rustdoc

Add a 'Canonical source' link in the rustdoc of each Profile and Lint impl pointing to the specific BR section it interprets. Example:



Use the GitHub anchor IDs (which github auto-generates from heading text — e.g. '7.1.2.7.12 Subscriber Certificate Subject Alternative Name' becomes '#712712-subscriber-certificate-subject-alternative-name'). Verify each anchor resolves before committing.

### Per-constant rustdoc

CABF_TLS_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS, CABF_SMIME_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS, CABF_CS_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS already have doc comments citing the BR section. Add the canonical URL alongside.

## Relationship to PKIX-d5rh

PKIX-d5rh fixes WHAT section to cite (the section-number refresh). This bead fixes HOW citations are presented (markdown links + PR invitation). The two could be done in one PR if convenient — they touch the same files — but they have independent acceptance criteria.

Recommended order: do PKIX-d5rh first (settles which sections to cite), then this bead (annotates them with URLs + PR invitation). Doing this bead first would lock in URLs that the d5rh refresh will need to update.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Crate-level 'Reporting divergences' section added to pkix-profiles-cabf/src/lib.rs
- [ ] Crate-level 'Reporting divergences' section added to pkix-lint-cabf/src/lib.rs
- [ ] Per-Profile rustdoc: WebPkiProfile, SmimeProfile, CodeSigningProfile have 'Canonical source' links
- [ ] Per-Lint rustdoc: ValidityMaxLint, Sha1ProhibitedLint, RsaMinKeySizeLint, SanRequiredLint, EkuServerAuthLint, BcCaFlagLint have 'Canonical source' links
- [ ] Per-constant rustdoc: CABF_*_ALLOWED_ALGS have canonical URLs
- [ ] All URLs resolve (manually verify or write a doctest that fetches a HEAD)
- [ ] cargo doc builds clean (no broken intra-doc-link warnings) — note: there is a pre-existing broken intra-doc-link error at pkix-lint-cabf/src/cabf_tls_br.rs:601 (`pkix_path::Profile`) that should be fixed in passing
- [ ] CHANGELOG entries

## Out of scope

- Changing which section is cited (that is PKIX-d5rh)
- Adding annotations to non-CABF crates (this is specific to the unprincipled-exception crates)
- Adding URL links for non-BR references (RFC links, etc.) — those are independently useful but bigger scope

## Audit reference

Filed 2026-05-12 alongside PKIX-d5rh. Both surfaced during the CABF spec refresh session (commit 3ae0283c). Mark's design intent: the unprincipled-exception clause in AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5 accepts ongoing maintenance burden; this bead makes that burden community-shareable by inviting external contributions to fix divergences.

## Cross-references

- PKIX-d5rh (citation refresh — should land first)
- AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5 unprincipled-exception clause
- specs/cabforum-*.md (canonical local copies — these documents drive the URL targets above)
- specs/README.md CABF section (lists source URLs)
title: Add canonical CABF spec source URLs + 'PR divergences please' invitation to -cabf crate rustdoc
